contract.title: D1 dynamic link rate round-7 cold-start review (commit 408d368)
contract.goal: Review exact commit 408d368cd31f0990d39480eff962dd53f49bb95b on branch codex/20260819-d1-dynamic-rate. Round-6 (commit 3acb6ce) REQUEST_CHANGES findings, both claimed fixed, to re-verify with fresh adversarial reading: (finding 1, major) the normal _decide() zero-rate path must no longer degrade to time_step polling: parked packets must get a certified re-decision wake at the exact packet deadline and at MCS/GE recovery -- verify _schedule_pending_wake/_pending_wake_once (one-shot timeout, earliest-wake guard, no stale double re-decision), _decide entry deadline now inclusive (>=), the GSL deliver zero-rate branch scheduling next_slant_range_under / GE next_up / deadline, the ISL candidate loop scheduling next_isl_range_under / GE next_up / deadline, and the new regressions test_mcs_zero_rate_pending_expires_at_exact_deadline_not_tick (0.5 exact, not 0.7) and test_mcs_zero_rate_pending_recovers_at_exact_range_crossing_not_tick (1.0 exact, not 1.4). (finding 2, major) GE attribution queries in _decide GSL/ISL branches and ISLLink.available_now() must increment ge_gsl_queries/ge_isl_queries so receipt effective.ge is not a false negative when GE is the actual blocker -- verify the counter increments and the new regressions test_mcs_ge_gated_deliver_decision_counts_ge_query and test_isl_ge_down_pre_gate_counts_query_without_transmit; also confirm no regression in existing tests asserting ge_isl_queries == 0 for GSL-only scenarios (test_outage_trace_gaps) and that _transmit counter increments are not double-counted in a way that breaks receipt semantics. Also re-confirm round-4/5/6 items remain: F2-RACE unconditional deadline sweep, F3 stop_time >= deadline inclusive, F4 attribution only when geometry AND GE up, F5 constant-rate GSL pre-gate, F1-R immediate hard-retirement cleanup, downlink non-head deadline certified wait. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES with FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, exact path/line evidence, concrete reproduction conditions, severity and open_items. Do not modify code.
